description:
Get a decision gateway's answers

How a decision gateway answered over the last 24 hours or 7 days: for each question of its config, how many requests answered it and, for a choice or a yes/no question, each answer's count, most frequent first (at most 12, the rest as other); for a score, the mean and the share at or above 0.5. requests counts the decisions calls through the gateway in the range. A chat gateway answers 400 invalid_request.

range.description: The last 24 hours (per hour) or the last 7 days (per day).

name: gateway_decisions
title: Get a decision gateway's answers
